objects.name: Volt Typhoon KV-Botnet Edge Router Zero-Day & Living-off-the-Land Campaign (CVE-2026-21409)
objects.description: Volt Typhoon (Bronze Silhouette) is actively exploiting CVE-2026-21409, a critical pre-authentication command injection flaw in enterprise SD-WAN and SOHO edge appliances.
